units.rawText: Those living a life full of real life activities won't become internet trolls.

units.rawText: That being said... How many people really live such fulfilling lives? I guess that isn't really the case. Everyone is only trying to relieve their stress online. Some people watch livestreams, while some others talk trash and start fights.
